GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok faced breeze half off, pushed along turn, Straightened Up half off, same 200m, run ended approaching 100m, only fair late # faced breeze
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: After rearing in the barriers, was backed out of its stall and underwent a pre-race veterinary examination before being passed fit to start by the veterinary officer. Rider dropped his whip approaching the 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down long last 14 lengths. last turn. Held Ground # Not Sighted
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: After making the first turn extremely wide, was then shifted behind runners to obtain cover. When questioned regarding the performance rider stated that it was her intention settle in a more forward position as notified to Stewards and after beginning well, she attempted to do so, however, the mare failed to muster early speed despite her urgings. She further stated that her mount then raced flat for the remainder of the event and did not let down as she had expected after straightening. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped fairly. Not pushed early & raced @ rear Two Wide (6L from lead). Stayed @ rear Two Wide until 3 Wide @ 600m & Five Wide @ 500m. Pushed to quicken Seven Wide (6L from lead) on home turn. Pressured @ 300m & ran on soundly in last 200m. # Sound from rear
Jumped Ok Went Forward to lead 1 Lengths 600m .5 Lengths lead Straightened Up 1st kicked away 100m to win well # led/too strong late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid inwards while under pressure in the home straight. Rider was reminded of her obligations to straighten her mounts when shifting ground.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 3 Wide with cover 3 lengths. Wide turn under pressure. weakened # covered ground
Jumped Ok Settled Down 2nd 2 Lengths 800m 3rd rail home turn Narrow Lead kicked clear 300m Kept Going Too Well # pace/held on late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped runner. When questioned regarding the improved performance trainer stated that he was surprised by the performance of horse and felt that the mare may have appreciated the long spell and the addition of blinkers. He further added that the mare may have also appreciated the Heavy (9) surface. Trainers explanation was noted.
Slow to begin. Crowded shortly after.
On arrival to the start underwent a pre-race veterinary examination at the request of rider and was passed suitable to race.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. got up fence turn 4 lengths. weakened # poor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was permitted to ride 1 kilogram over the allotted weight of 55 kilograms. Bumped at the start.
Raced three-wide for the majority of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat handy 2 Lengths off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 3l off all clear, found little and faded # weak run home
